title: SEITI RMLab: A costless and effective remote measurement laboratory in electrical engineering
reason: Describes the SEITI RMLab remote measurement lab; evaluation is a crossover of 31 students through hands-on/remote modes followed by a survey rating 12 issues (availability, ease of use...). No platform indicator is related to performance or traits.

extraction.design: system description plus crossover usage and satisfaction survey
extraction.n_quote: We divided a panel of 31 students into three groups: G1: 9 students, G2: 11
extraction.notes: Remote-lab assessments exist in the platform but are not analysed against usage.
